mapper.insert: insert into CHB_SYS_PAGE_DICTLIST_HIS(PAGE_ID, HIS_NO, DICT_ID, DICT_ITEM_VAL, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) select PAGE_ID, (select IFNULL(max(HIS_NO), 0) from CHB_SYS_PAGE_DICTLIST_HIS where STATUS IN('E','D')) + 1 as HIS_NO, DICT_ID, DICT_ITEM_VAL, STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} as UPDATE_USER, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} as UPDATE_TIME from CHB_SYS_PAGE_DICTLIST where STATUS IN('E','D')
